kind: direct-packed tied-vocabulary product quantization component diagnostic

representation.direct_output: 256 centroid dot products per subspace plus code gather/sum times token norm

fit: six deterministic full-vocabulary Lloyd iterations per subspace using pretrained embedding weights only
evaluation: 8192 next-token predictions from WikiText-2 raw test at context512; occurrence embedding NMSE, head-only PPL, integrated input+head PPL, and direct packed semantic conformance

component_gate.pass: >=5x tied-Q4 reduction; embedding NMSE <=0.05; head-only PPL <=1.05x; integrated <=1.10x; semantic error <=1e-4

claim_boundary: Component-only fixed-slice quality and exact representation bytes. No Q4_K_M parity, native optimized kernel, RSS, VRAM or whole-model claim.
